import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; export default function DispatchModal({ simData, onClose, onComplete, onCancel }) { const [stage, setStage] = useState('searching'); // searching | matched | completed useEffect(() => { if (!simData) return; setStage('searching'); const timer = setTimeout(() => { setStage('matched'); }, 1200); return () => clearTimeout(timer); }, [simData]); if (!simData) return null; return (

🚖 DiyaTaxi Ride Dispatcher

{stage === 'searching' && (
🚖

Contacting Nearby Drivers...

Broadcasting booking request in {simData.order.City} for {simData.order.VehicleType}

)} {stage === 'matched' && (
✓

Driver Confirmed!

Arriving at {simData.order.PickupLocation.Area} in ~3 mins

{simData.driver.Name.charAt(0)}
{simData.driver.Name}
{simData.driver.Phone} • ★ 4.9
{simData.driver.VehicleType}
START TRIP OTP
7294
Passenger {simData.passengerName} {simData.passengerPhone && simData.passengerPhone !== 'N/A' ? `(${simData.passengerPhone})` : ''}
Assigned Vehicle {simData.driver.VehicleType} • {simData.driver.VehicleNumber}
Distance Rate {simData.distanceKm} km × ₹{simData.breakdown?.perKm || 12}/km = ₹{simData.breakdown?.distanceCost || (simData.fare - 35)}
Base Fare ₹{simData.breakdown?.baseFare || 35}
Payment Mode {simData.delivery.PaymentMode}
Total Calculated Fare ₹{simData.fare}
)} {stage === 'completed' && (
🏁

Trip Completed!

Fare ₹{simData.fare} received via {simData.delivery.PaymentMode}. Order #{simData.order.OrderID} recorded in DiyaTaxi.

)}
); }
